production_change: Evaluate the existing shared PooledMemoryStream instead of a growable MemoryStream during BSON TempData serialization. Retain the independently owned byte-array result, validation, empty/null fast paths, writer lifetime and existing serializer settings. Do not impose a new payload limit.
history: The original stream/ToArray seam dates to cookie TempData support in 89bd6dc1cd188772f9b85eb75ec0d79506a3bf2f (2016-09-07). Newtonsoft.Json.Bson is pinned to 1.0.2; its real writer uses BinaryWriter for type markers, lengths, terminators and UTF-8 payloads.
compatibility: Original/final owning NewtonsoftJson suites and each individual focused BsonTempDataSerializerTest outcome pass.
All 21 actual DI-resolved BSON serializer cases preserve exact serialized bytes, complete round-trip dictionaries and returned-array ownership.
String and Unicode BSON bytes are checked against independently encoded BSON document/string framing; every nonempty case records its payload SHA-256 and complete deserialized JSON.
An untimed real CookieTempDataProvider save/load consumes the DI-resolved serializer, produces real response cookies and restores the complete mixed dictionary.
Unsupported objects retain the exact existing InvalidOperationException before serialization; null/empty output remains Array.Empty<byte>().
No exported API, serializer configuration, dependency version or retained metadata cache is changed.

measurement.scope: Warmed real serializer and ArrayPool behavior. Cookie protection/chunking and round-trip deserialization are preflight contracts, not timed operations.
measurement.policy: Retain every timing/allocation trade-off and both empty/null controls. Large payloads are stress cases, not claims about typical cookie sizes.

hot_reload: The proposal changes per-call stream storage only; it does not add or alter retained type/member metadata.
tuning_after_round_1: Keep the complete first pair. The initial pool-only prototype improves large text cases but increases all six array allocations and many array/small-input times. BSON 1.0.2 writes type markers and terminators through BinaryWriter; the existing pooled helper inherits Stream.WriteByte. Add a minimal WriteByte override delegating to the existing span Write path. The existing 25 shared-stream tests already cover WriteByte growth, sparse gaps, maximum capacity, position overflow and disposal. Validate them original/final. This shared-source tune changes both the NewtonsoftJson and WebUtilities DLLs; disclose and hash both, rather than claiming a target-only binary difference. Two measured comparisons remain.
existing_validation_exclusions: The owning suite skips NewtonsoftJsonInputFormatterTest.JsonFormatter_EscapedKeys_SingleQuote under its existing Fact(Skip) for dotnet/aspnetcore#39069. All 50 BSON cases run and pass; this unrelated formatter assertion is not reached.

The original BsonTempDataSerializerTest.cs contains a UTF-8 BOM. Original/current formatter checks both report only CHARSET; preserve it under the minimal-diff policy. Both changed shipping C# files pass whitespace checks; no new whitespace diagnostic.
